title: Google Ads Account Access & Campaign Optimisation
accessRequired:
Google Ads invitation received but is read-only. Needs upgrade to Standard access.

Fix: Google Ads → Admin → Access & Security → change role to Standard.
whyItMatters: Every dirham spent on Google Ads right now runs without expert oversight. Standard access unlocks the full audit — where budget is going, what's wasted, and what to optimise — improving ROAS without increasing spend.
blocker:
Invitation email received → role is Read-Only.
Business action needed: resend invite at Standard level, or upgrade existing invite in the Google Ads admin panel.

title: Website User Behaviour Analysis — WordPress + Correct GTM
accessRequired:

2. GTM-N8GMVMW4 — the correct active container with real historical tracking data.

whyItMatters: Knowing where users drop off, which pages convert, and what happens before a WhatsApp lead is submitted lets us improve conversion without spending more on ads. Without the correct GTM container, all decisions are guesswork.
blocker:
GTM-N8GMVMW4 → Active · has historical data · live firing ✓ — access needed here
GTM-56X728BG → Created 3 days ago · no data · no firing ✗ — do not grant this one

title: WhatsApp Lead Channel — Conflict Resolution & Optimisation
accessRequired: No external access required — investigation and recommendation task. Business team cooperation needed to implement the fix.
whyItMatters: WhatsApp is a primary lead channel. Every day this conflict is unresolved, inbound leads hit a broken or unresponsive experience — directly costing revenue. Fix restores the channel and opens the path to a proper multi-agent setup.
blocker:
1. Log out all active sessions → WhatsApp Web → ⋮ → Linked Devices → log out all → reconnect cleanly from one primary device
2. Migrate to WhatsApp Business API via BSP (Interakt / WATI / 360dialog) — allows multiple agents on one number, legally
3. Dedicated second number for WhatsApp Business if community features need to stay separate

Recommendation will follow once current session state is fully mapped.
